title.ja: IOR easy型 / write

status.ja: 容量限定のIO500-inspired実験・Foundation未検証（unverified）・公式スコアではありません
status.en: Bounded IO500-inspired experiment; unverified by IO500® Foundation; not an official score

results.software: IOR 4.0.0 / commit 967a9f65109760db8a3ac14a7fdd007f337d2960; reference IO500 SC26 v1

conditions.ja: 1ノード、4 MPI ranks、POSIX、3独立反復。2 MiB transfer・16 GiB/rank・file per process。barrier、fsync、read reorder offset=1、timestamp signature=27。読込は-Rのデータ検証を含みます。
conditions.en: 1 node, 4 MPI ranks, POSIX, 3 independent repetitions. 2 MiB transfer・16 GiB/rank・file per process. Barriers, fsync, read reorder offset=1, timestamp signature=27; reads include -R data verification.

limitations.ja: IO500 SC26 v1を参照した固定容量実験。300秒write stonewallなし、IOR版も参照実装のpinと異なります。mdtest/findを含むIO500総合スコアを計算していません。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume experiment based on IO500 SC26 v1, without 300-second write stonewall; IOR version differs from the reference pin. No IO500 composite score calculated.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。1ノード内のreorderでは共有page cacheを排除できません。logical bytes/timeであり物理デバイス帯域は未検証。 キャッシュ条件は未制御です。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O without global cache flush; same-node reorder cannot remove shared page cache. Logical bytes/time; physical device bandwidth unverified. Cache conditions are uncontrolled.

limitations.ja: hardは約1.751 GiB/反復で短時間。全反復と変動を保持し、専有環境の最大性能とは解釈しません。
limitations.en: Hard uses approximately 1.751 GiB per repetition and is short. All repetitions and variability retained; not dedicated-system peak performance.

limitations.ja: 2026-10-04に取得したSC26 v1参照条件を使用。SC26の安定化期間（10月2–16日）中のため最終確定仕様とは扱いません。
limitations.en: Uses SC26 v1 reference conditions captured on 2026-10-04 during the October 2–16 stabilization period; not treated as finalized specifications.

reproduction.commands:
# 1 node, 4 MPI ranks. Run phases in this order for each independent trial.
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/easy-$trial" "$OUT"
  mpirun -np 4 "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 16g -s 1 -w > "$OUT/easy-$trial-write.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 4 "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 16g -s 1 -r -R > "$OUT/easy-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
done

notes.ja: 内部の実行パスのみ変数に置換しています。空の専用ディレクトリを用意し、DATAを測定対象ファイルシステム、OUTをログ保存先、BINを実行バイナリのディレクトリに設定してください。計測値は共有環境・未制御キャッシュの観測で、同じ値の再現を保証しません。
notes.en: Only private execution paths are replaced by variables. Use empty dedicated directories; set DATA to the measured filesystem, OUT to log storage, BIN to the binary directory. Shared-system and uncontrolled-cache observations do not guarantee identical performance.

notes.ja: IOR 4.0.0の記載commitでビルドしたIOR/mdtestと互換MPIを使用します。各反復は新しいデータ領域で実行し、write→readまたはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順を保持。グローバルcache flushは実施していません。
notes.en: Use IOR/mdtest built from the recorded IOR 4.0.0 commit with compatible MPI. Use a fresh dataset per repetition and preserve write→read or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove order. No global cache flush was performed.

results.software: mdtest / IOR 4.0.0 commit 967a9f65109760db8a3ac14a7fdd007f337d2960; reference IO500 SC26 v1

conditions.ja: 1ノード、4 MPI ranks、POSIX、2000 files/rank（合計8000）、3独立反復、depth=0、branching=1、neighbor stride=1。0-byte files、processごとのunique directory、leafのみ(-u -L)。hard readは-Xデータ検証。IOR完了後に直列実施。
conditions.en: 1 node, 4 MPI ranks, POSIX, 2000 files/rank (8000 total), 3 independent repetitions; depth=0, branching=1, neighbor stride=1. zero-byte files, unique directory per process, leaf only (-u -L). Hard reads use -X verification. Measured serially after IOR.

metrics.label: Pooled rate (total file operations / total time)

limitations.ja: 正式設定100万files/rankから縮小し、300秒create stonewallなし。共有nodeの全I/Oをflushする-Yを省略しました。参照実装のIOR版pinとも異なります。
limitations.en: Reduced from 1 million files/rank; no 300-second create stonewall. Global node sync (-Y) omitted to limit impact on shared users. IOR version differs from reference pin.

limitations.ja: cache flushなし。1ノード内のneighbor strideではpage cacheを除けません。cache影響を受け得るstat/readと短時間・小規模の観測であり最大性能ではありません。 キャッシュ条件は未制御です。

limitations.ja: easyに正式IO500 read phaseはありません。未測定readを0で補完していません。hardはcreate/stat/read/remove全段階を保持。
limitations.en: IO500 easy has no read phase; missing read is not imputed as zero. All hard create/stat/read/remove phases retained.

limitations.ja: 2026-10-04に取得したSC26 v1参照条件を使用。SC26の安定化期間（10月2–16日）中のため最終確定仕様とは扱いません。

limitations.ja: 省略したmdtest -Yはノード全体のsyncです。IOR -Y（各write後fsync）とは異なります。
limitations.en: Omitted mdtest -Y is node-wide sync; distinct from IOR -Y (fsync after each write).

done

title.ja: IOR easy / read · 第1ラウンド

status.ja: 暫定：時間分散3ラウンド中1ラウンドのみ。Foundation未検証・公式スコアではありません。
status.en: Preliminary: only round 1 of 3 time-separated rounds. Foundation unverified; not an official score

conditions.ja: 1ノード、4 MPI ranks、4 ranks/node、4 GPU/nodeのexclusive allocation（GPU計算なし）、POSIX、各条件3反復。fixed total 512 GiB; strong scaling; 2 MiB transfers; file per process。
conditions.en: 1 nodes, 4 MPI ranks, 4 ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node exclusive allocation (no GPU computation), POSIX, 3 trials. fixed total 512 GiB; strong scaling; 2 MiB transfers; file per process.

limitations.ja: round2/3は未取得。256ノードIOR hardはwriteが3,600秒でtimeoutし、read未実施。欠測値は0として描画せず、hardのグラフは128ノードまで。
limitations.en: Rounds 2/3 are pending. 256-node IOR hard write timed out after 3,600 seconds; read was not reached. Missing values are not plotted as zero; hard graphs end at 128 nodes.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IORのQ=1のrank reorderは多くが同一ノード内で、cold cacheは保証しません。logical throughput/operation rateであり物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境の観測で、公式IO500合成スコアではありません。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O; no global cache flush. IOR Q=1 rank reorder mostly stays within a node and does not establish cold cache. Logical throughput/operation rate, not physical device bandwidth. Shared-system observations; no official IO500 composite score.

limitations.ja: 300秒stonewallなしの固定容量実験。従来1ノードeasy（総64 GiB）とは別系列。全3反復、中央値、平均、範囲、標準偏差、総量/総時間を保持。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume experiment without 300-second stonewall. Separate from legacy one-node easy (64 GiB total). All 3 trials, median, mean, range, sample deviation and total amount / total time retained.

limitations.ja: 最初の1ノード試行はメモリ不足で失敗し、メモリ割当を全ノードメモリへ修正。128ノードhardは600秒timeout後に1,800秒で再測定。失敗試行は性能集計から除外し、成功時の条件を記載しています。
limitations.en: The initial one-node attempt failed from insufficient allocated memory; allocation was corrected to all node memory. 128-node hard was remeasured with a 1,800-second phase cap after a 600-second timeout. Failed attempts are excluded from performance aggregates; successful conditions are stated.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 1 nodes, 4 MPI ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node, exclusive, all node memory.
# Original module: nvhpc-hpcx/26.5. GPU computation is not measured.
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/ior-easy-$trial" "$OUT"
  mpirun -np 4 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/ior-easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 137438953472 -s 1 -w -O summaryFormat=JSON -O summaryFile="$OUT/ior-easy-$trial-write.json" > "$OUT/ior-easy-$trial-write.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 4 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/ior-easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 137438953472 -s 1 -r -R -O summaryFormat=JSON -O summaryFile="$OUT/ior-easy-$trial-read.json" > "$OUT/ior-easy-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
done

notes.ja: BINは記載commitからビルドしたIOR/mdtest、DATAは十分な空き容量のある測定対象FSの専用空ディレクトリ、OUTはログ保存先。private pathのみ変数へ置換。実行時は各phaseに外部timeout（IOR:64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒；mdtest300秒）を設定。反復ごとに結果を検証して生成データだけを削除し、新しい領域で次の反復を実施。
notes.en: BIN contains IOR/mdtest built from the pinned commit; DATA is a dedicated empty directory on the tested FS with sufficient space; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are replaced by variables. External phase timeouts: IOR <=64 nodes 600s, 128 nodes 1800s, 256 easy 3600s; mdtest 300s. Validate each trial then remove only its generated payload before the next fresh trial.

notes.ja: write→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeを維持。今回第1ラウンドは2026-10-05 UTCに逐次測定。ノード数ごとの測定時刻は同一ではなく、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
notes.en: Preserve write→read (-R verification) or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove. Round 1 ran serially on 2026-10-05 UTC; node counts were not measured simultaneously, so environmental variation cannot be separated from scaling.

conditions.ja: 2ノード、8 MPI ranks、4 ranks/node、4 GPU/nodeのexclusive allocation（GPU計算なし）、POSIX、各条件3反復。fixed total 512 GiB; strong scaling; 2 MiB transfers; file per process。
conditions.en: 2 nodes, 8 MPI ranks, 4 ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node exclusive allocation (no GPU computation), POSIX, 3 trials. fixed total 512 GiB; strong scaling; 2 MiB transfers; file per process.

limitations.ja: round2/3は未取得。256ノードIOR hardはwriteが3,600秒でtimeoutし、read未実施。欠測値は0として描画せず、hardのグラフは128ノードまで。
limitations.en: Rounds 2/3 are pending. 256-node IOR hard write timed out after 3,600 seconds; read was not reached. Missing values are not plotted as zero; hard graphs end at 128 nodes.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IORのQ=1のrank reorderは多くが同一ノード内で、cold cacheは保証しません。logical throughput/operation rateであり物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境の観測で、公式IO500合成スコアではありません。

limitations.ja: 300秒stonewallなしの固定容量実験。従来1ノードeasy（総64 GiB）とは別系列。全3反復、中央値、平均、範囲、標準偏差、総量/総時間を保持。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume experiment without 300-second stonewall. Separate from legacy one-node easy (64 GiB total). All 3 trials, median, mean, range, sample deviation and total amount / total time retained.

limitations.ja: 最初の1ノード試行はメモリ不足で失敗し、メモリ割当を全ノードメモリへ修正。128ノードhardは600秒timeout後に1,800秒で再測定。失敗試行は性能集計から除外し、成功時の条件を記載しています。
limitations.en: The initial one-node attempt failed from insufficient allocated memory; allocation was corrected to all node memory. 128-node hard was remeasured with a 1,800-second phase cap after a 600-second timeout. Failed attempts are excluded from performance aggregates; successful conditions are stated.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 2 nodes, 4 MPI ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node, exclusive, all node memory.
# Original module: nvhpc-hpcx/26.5. GPU computation is not measured.
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/ior-easy-$trial" "$OUT"
  mpirun -np 8 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/ior-easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 68719476736 -s 1 -w -O summaryFormat=JSON -O summaryFile="$OUT/ior-easy-$trial-write.json" > "$OUT/ior-easy-$trial-write.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 8 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/ior-easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 68719476736 -s 1 -r -R -O summaryFormat=JSON -O summaryFile="$OUT/ior-easy-$trial-read.json" > "$OUT/ior-easy-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
done

notes.ja: BINは記載commitからビルドしたIOR/mdtest、DATAは十分な空き容量のある測定対象FSの専用空ディレクトリ、OUTはログ保存先。private pathのみ変数へ置換。実行時は各phaseに外部timeout（IOR:64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒；mdtest300秒）を設定。反復ごとに結果を検証して生成データだけを削除し、新しい領域で次の反復を実施。
notes.en: BIN contains IOR/mdtest built from the pinned commit; DATA is a dedicated empty directory on the tested FS with sufficient space; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are replaced by variables. External phase timeouts: IOR <=64 nodes 600s, 128 nodes 1800s, 256 easy 3600s; mdtest 300s. Validate each trial then remove only its generated payload before the next fresh trial.

notes.ja: write→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeを維持。今回第1ラウンドは2026-10-05 UTCに逐次測定。ノード数ごとの測定時刻は同一ではなく、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
notes.en: Preserve write→read (-R verification) or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove. Round 1 ran serially on 2026-10-05 UTC; node counts were not measured simultaneously, so environmental variation cannot be separated from scaling.

limitations.ja: round2/3は未取得。256ノードIOR hardはwriteが3,600秒でtimeoutし、read未実施。欠測値は0として描画せず、hardのグラフは128ノードまで。
limitations.en: Rounds 2/3 are pending. 256-node IOR hard write timed out after 3,600 seconds; read was not reached. Missing values are not plotted as zero; hard graphs end at 128 nodes.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IORのQ=1のrank reorderは多くが同一ノード内で、cold cacheは保証しません。logical throughput/operation rateであり物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境の観測で、公式IO500合成スコアではありません。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O; no global cache flush. IOR Q=1 rank reorder mostly stays within a node and does not establish cold cache. Logical throughput/operation rate, not physical device bandwidth. Shared-system observations; no official IO500 composite score.

limitations.ja: 300秒stonewallなしの固定容量実験。従来1ノードeasy（総64 GiB）とは別系列。全3反復、中央値、平均、範囲、標準偏差、総量/総時間を保持。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume experiment without 300-second stonewall. Separate from legacy one-node easy (64 GiB total). All 3 trials, median, mean, range, sample deviation and total amount / total time retained.

limitations.ja: 最初の1ノード試行はメモリ不足で失敗し、メモリ割当を全ノードメモリへ修正。128ノードhardは600秒timeout後に1,800秒で再測定。失敗試行は性能集計から除外し、成功時の条件を記載しています。
limitations.en: The initial one-node attempt failed from insufficient allocated memory; allocation was corrected to all node memory. 128-node hard was remeasured with a 1,800-second phase cap after a 600-second timeout. Failed attempts are excluded from performance aggregates; successful conditions are stated.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 8 nodes, 4 MPI ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node, exclusive, all node memory.
# Original module: nvhpc-hpcx/26.5. GPU computation is not measured.
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" "$OUT"
  mpirun -np 32 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -C --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-create.csv" > "$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-create.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 32 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -T --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.csv" > "$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 32 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -E -X --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-read.csv" > "$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 32 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -r --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-remove.csv" > "$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-remove.log" 2>&1
done

notes.ja: BINは記載commitからビルドしたIOR/mdtest、DATAは十分な空き容量のある測定対象FSの専用空ディレクトリ、OUTはログ保存先。private pathのみ変数へ置換。実行時は各phaseに外部timeout（IOR:64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒；mdtest300秒）を設定。反復ごとに結果を検証して生成データだけを削除し、新しい領域で次の反復を実施。
notes.en: BIN contains IOR/mdtest built from the pinned commit; DATA is a dedicated empty directory on the tested FS with sufficient space; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are replaced by variables. External phase timeouts: IOR <=64 nodes 600s, 128 nodes 1800s, 256 easy 3600s; mdtest 300s. Validate each trial then remove only its generated payload before the next fresh trial.

notes.ja: write→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeを維持。今回第1ラウンドは2026-10-05 UTCに逐次測定。ノード数ごとの測定時刻は同一ではなく、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
notes.en: Preserve write→read (-R verification) or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove. Round 1 ran serially on 2026-10-05 UTC; node counts were not measured simultaneously, so environmental variation cannot be separated from scaling.

limitations.ja: 最初の1ノード試行はメモリ不足で失敗し、メモリ割当を全ノードメモリへ修正。128ノードhardは600秒timeout後に1,800秒で再測定。失敗試行は性能集計から除外し、成功時の条件を記載しています。
limitations.en: The initial one-node attempt failed from insufficient allocated memory; allocation was corrected to all node memory. 128-node hard was remeasured with a 1,800-second phase cap after a 600-second timeout. Failed attempts are excluded from performance aggregates; successful conditions are stated.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 128 nodes, 4 MPI ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node, exclusive, all node memory.
# Original module: nvhpc-hpcx/26.5. GPU computation is not measured.
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" "$OUT"
  mpirun -np 512 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -C --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-create.csv" > "$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-create.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 512 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -T --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.csv" > "$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 512 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -E -X --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-read.csv" > "$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 512 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -r --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-remove.csv" > "$OUT/mdtest-hard-$trial-remove.log" 2>&1
done

notes.ja: BINは記載commitからビルドしたIOR/mdtest、DATAは十分な空き容量のある測定対象FSの専用空ディレクトリ、OUTはログ保存先。private pathのみ変数へ置換。実行時は各phaseに外部timeout（IOR:64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒；mdtest300秒）を設定。反復ごとに結果を検証して生成データだけを削除し、新しい領域で次の反復を実施。
notes.en: BIN contains IOR/mdtest built from the pinned commit; DATA is a dedicated empty directory on the tested FS with sufficient space; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are replaced by variables. External phase timeouts: IOR <=64 nodes 600s, 128 nodes 1800s, 256 easy 3600s; mdtest 300s. Validate each trial then remove only its generated payload before the next fresh trial.

notes.ja: write→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeを維持。今回第1ラウンドは2026-10-05 UTCに逐次測定。ノード数ごとの測定時刻は同一ではなく、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
notes.en: Preserve write→read (-R verification) or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove. Round 1 ran serially on 2026-10-05 UTC; node counts were not measured simultaneously, so environmental variation cannot be separated from scaling.

title.ja: mdtest hard / stat · 第1ラウンド

status.ja: 暫定：時間分散3ラウンド中1ラウンドのみ。Foundation未検証・公式スコアではありません。
status.en: Preliminary: only round 1 of 3 time-separated rounds. Foundation unverified; not an official score

conditions.ja: 256ノード、1024 MPI ranks、4 ranks/node、4 GPU/nodeのexclusive allocation（GPU計算なし）、POSIX、各条件3反復。2,000 files/rank; shared tree; 3,901-byte write/read payload。
conditions.en: 256 nodes, 1024 MPI ranks, 4 ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node exclusive allocation (no GPU computation), POSIX, 3 trials. 2,000 files/rank; shared tree; 3,901-byte write/read payload.

limitations.ja: round2/3は未取得。256ノードIOR hardはwriteが3,600秒でtimeoutし、read未実施。欠測値は0として描画せず、hardのグラフは128ノードまで。
limitations.en: Rounds 2/3 are pending. 256-node IOR hard write timed out after 3,600 seconds; read was not reached. Missing values are not plotted as zero; hard graphs end at 128 nodes.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IORのQ=1のrank reorderは多くが同一ノード内で、cold cacheは保証しません。logical throughput/operation rateであり物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境の観測で、公式IO500合成スコアではありません。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O; no global cache flush. IOR Q=1 rank reorder mostly stays within a node and does not establish cold cache. Logical throughput/operation rate, not physical device bandwidth. Shared-system observations; no official IO500 composite score.

comparison_rule.ja: 同一ソフトウェア版・シナリオ・API・ノード/MPI配置・データ量・キャッシュ条件・反復数と妥当性を揃えて比較します。未実測のシステムを補完しません。 異種指標16件を合成スコアに集約しません。IORはMiB/s÷1024でGiB/s、mdtestはops/s÷1000でkops/sに換算できます。
comparison_rule.en: Compare matching software versions, scenarios, APIs, node/MPI placement, data volume, cache conditions, repetitions, and validity. Missing system measurements remain missing. The 16 heterogeneous observations are not combined into a score. IOR GiB/s = MiB/s ÷ 1024; mdtest kops/s = ops/s ÷ 1000.
